theater: 庫爾斯克突出部與別爾哥羅德

battle.name: 庫爾斯克
battle.theater: 庫爾斯克突出部與別爾哥羅德
battle.brief: 一九四三年七月至八月，德軍在奧廖爾與別爾哥羅德兩側向蘇聯突出部發動「雪崩」攻勢，蘇軍以縱深陣地、地雷帶遲滯正面，再以四個方面軍反攻奪回哈爾科夫。虎式與豹式能打穿單點，卻打不穿整個突出部。卡面 T-34-85 一九四四年量產，八十五公厘砲與傾斜裝甲成為蘇軍縱深突破的標準配備。

kit.name: T-34-85
kit.history: 85 公厘砲改善對虎式與豹式的劣勢。斜面裝甲與可量產性，比任何單車決鬥更決定東線。

countries: 庫爾斯克會戰是一九四三年七月至八月在蘇聯中部中央方面軍戰區進行的一場戰略戰役，蘇德雙方在奧廖爾、庫爾斯克與別爾哥羅德之間的突出部上對峙，正面寬約三百公里，縱深一百五十至二百公里。交戰一方是德國及其軸心國體系：德軍南方集團軍群由曼陀菲爾元帥指揮，突擊兵力集中在第4裝甲集團軍（先由克萊斯特將軍率軍，赫普特中將於七月十一日接掌，豪瑟的第2武裝裝甲軍團配屬其下）、第9軍（莫德爾元帥）、第2裝甲軍，以及第16、第57、第3、第4裝甲師，另有第48裝甲軍等預備隊，帝國航空隊第九、第十一航空隊的大批機群負責支援；義大利、羅馬尼亞等盟國在北非與地中海其他戰區作戰，並未投入突出部攻勢。另一方是蘇聯紅軍：沃羅涅日方面軍由瓦丘切夫上將指揮，中央方面軍在攻勢發動前夕由預備方面軍改組而成、由瓦丘切夫接任，草原方面軍由戈爾科夫上將率領，並以羅科索夫斯基的第5近衛坦克集團軍、崔可夫的第7集團軍等精銳放在突破口一側待命。蘇軍在突出部內由中央與沃羅涅日兩個方面軍防守，總兵力遠多於德軍突擊集群，並以縱深梯次不斷補線。戰役在德軍攻勢與蘇軍反攻兩個方向同時展開，雙方的差距並不只在坦克數量，更在補給、機動與指揮體系的完整度。
countriesEn: The Battle of Kursk was a strategic engagement fought in the central Soviet sector between July and August 1943, with the two sides locked together inside the salient that bulged out between Orel, Kursk and Belgorod, a front about three hundred kilometres wide and one hundred and fifty to two hundred kilometres deep. One side was Germany and the Axis system built around it: the German Army Group South was commanded by Field Marshal von Manstein, and the assault was concentrated in the 4th Panzer Army (first led by General Kleist, taken over by General Hoth on 11 July, with SS-Obergruppenführer Hausser's II SS Panzer Corps attached), the 9th Army under Field Marshal Model, the 2nd Panzer Corps, and the 16th, 57th, 3rd and 4th Panzer Divisions, with the 48th Panzer Corps and other formations in reserve, and with the large air fleets of the Luftwaffe's Ninth and Eleventh Air Fleets in support. Italy, Romania and the other allies were committed in North Africa and on the other Mediterranean fronts and did not take part in the offensive inside the salient. The other side was the Red Army: the Voronezh Front under Marshal Vatutin, the Central Front, which was reorganised out of the Reserve Front on the eve of the attack and which Vatutin took over, and the Steppe Front under Marshal Konev, with shock formations such as Rokossovsky's 5th Guards Tank Army and Chuikov's 7th Army held to one side of the breach. The Central and Voronezh fronts held the salient with far more men than the German assault group, and fed fresh reserves into the fight from the depths. The campaign ran in two directions at once, the German attack and the Soviet counteroffensive, and the difference between the Axis and the Soviet Union lay not only in the number of tanks but in the completeness of their supply, manoeuvre and command systems.
people: 德軍方面，策劃「雪崩」與「冬日風暴」兩套方案的是曼陀菲爾元帥，他主張以南北兩支兵團在庫爾斯克會師、掐斷蘇聯突出部，再以精銳裝甲向縱深突進；他屢次要求推遲攻勢日期，好讓裝甲部隊完成補充，卻在最高統帥部直接派員前線督戰、以及希姆勒的推動之下，於一九四三年七月五日提前發動攻勢。實際指揮南翼突破的是第4裝甲集團軍，旗下第2裝甲軍與第11裝甲師銳意進取；豪瑟的第2武裝裝甲軍團自南面肩部向北實施牽制性突破；北面則由莫德爾的第9軍沿奧廖爾至別爾哥羅德鐵路兩側正面進攻。蘇聯方面，瓦丘切夫以中央方面軍司令員身分主持北面作戰並於八月負傷，戈爾科夫在草原方面軍與第5近衛坦克集團軍指揮南面反攻，羅特米斯特羅夫接掌第5近衛坦克集團軍，羅科索夫斯基的第5、第10近衛坦克軍在普羅霍羅夫卡一線組成反擊的鋼鐵拳頭。北面蘇軍的先手攻勢則是朱可夫與瓦西列夫斯基在總參謀部策劃的成果。德軍方面還有剛結束西西里戰役、被調任第4裝甲集團軍副司令的巴頓中將，以及在前線指揮游擊滲透與偵察的蘇軍游擊支隊指揮官。普羅霍羅夫卡一日之內的坦克交鋒，關鍵正在射程、光線與隊形三者的判斷，這也是這場會戰記錄中最常被引用的細節。
peopleEn: On the German side the two plans, 'Citadel' and 'Winter Storm', were the work of Field Marshal von Manstein, who wanted a pincer from the north and the south to meet at Kursk, cut off the Soviet salient and then drive the armoured fist into the depths. He asked repeatedly for the date to be postponed so that the panzer forces could be brought up to strength, yet under the pressure of the high command's own emissaries sent to the front and of Himmler's urging the offensive was brought forward to 5 July 1943. In practice the southern penetration was directed by the 4th Panzer Army, with the 2nd Panzer Corps and 11th Panzer Division leading the way, while Hausser's II SS Panzer Corps made a supporting push northward from the southern shoulder; in the north Model's 9th Army attacked frontally on both sides of the Orel–Belgorod railway. On the Soviet side Vatutin directed the northern fighting as commander of the Central Front and was wounded in August; Konev led the Steppe Front and the southern counteroffensive through the 5th Guards Tank Army, which Rotmistrov took over, with Rokossovsky's 5th and 10th Guards Tank Corps forming the steel fist at Prokhorovka. The Soviet opening move in the north was planned at the General Staff by Zhukov and Vasilevsky. On the German side there was also Patton, freshly released from Sicily and appointed deputy commander of the 4th Panzer Army, together with the Soviet partisan commanders who ran reconnaissance and infiltration in front of the line. In the single day of tank contact at Prokhorovka the decisive business was the judgement of range, light and formation, and that is the detail most often quoted from the battle's record.
kits: 卡面這件 T-34-85 是蘇聯自一九四四年起量產的新銳中型坦克，配 ZiS-S-53 八十五公厘戰列砲、五人乘員、傾斜裝甲與 V-2-34 引擎，採用多片離合器變速箱與差速器，車體的行程與傳動可靠性遠勝同期的德式平行傳動設計；但在一九四三年七月的庫爾斯克會戰中，蘇軍正面交戰的仍是配七十六公厘 F-34 砲的 T-34/76，只有為數不多的 T-34M 原型車與 SU-85 自走砲原型在戰場上試驗，八十五公厘線正式成軍要到一九四四年。蘇軍在戰役中的裝備組合是 T-34/76、少量 KV-1 與 IS-2 重型坦克、SU-152 與 SU-122 自走榴彈砲、四十五公厘反戰車砲、七十六公厘 ZIS-3 師屬砲、一百五十二公厘 M-20 榴彈砲、BM-13 火箭砲，步兵則配 PPSh-41 衝鋒槍與 DP-27 輕機槍。德軍的裝備以虎式（八十八公厘 KwK 36）與豹式（七十五公厘 KwK 42 及長身管）為攻勢骨幹，搭配四號與三號戰車、斐迪南與二式突擊砲、五十毫米突擊砲、一百五十公厘自行榴彈砲，以及大量以八十八公厘高射砲改裝的反戰車武器；空軍以 Ju 87 斯圖卡與 Henschel 129 執行對地攻擊，蘇軍則以 Il-2 與 Pe-2 掩護地面部隊。雙方都大量使用地雷，蘇軍在突破正面埋設縱深可達數公里的地雷帶，試圖以數量削減德軍裝甲銳氣。
kitsEn: The T-34-85 on the card face was the Soviet Union's new medium tank, put into series production from 1944: it carried the 85 mm ZiS-S-53 gun, a five-man crew, sloped armour and the V-2-34 engine, and used a multi-plate clutch gearbox with a differential, so that its running gear and transmission were far more reliable than the German parallel-gear designs of the day. In the fighting at Kursk in July 1943, however, the tank that met the enemy was still the T-34/76 with the 76.2 mm F-34 gun; only a small number of T-34M prototypes and SU-85 self-propelled gun prototypes were trialled on the battlefield, and the 85 mm line was not fielded as a standard until 1944. The Soviet inventory in the battle combined T-34/76s, a few KV-1 and IS-2 heavy tanks, SU-152 and SU-122 self-propelled howitzers, 45 mm anti-tank guns, 76.2 mm ZIS-3 regimental guns, 152 mm M-20 howitzers and BM-13 rocket launchers, with PPSh-41 submachine guns and DP-27 light machine guns in the infantry. The German equipment rested on the Tiger with its 88 mm KwK 36 and the Panther with the 75 mm KwK 42 and its long gun, backed by Panzer IV and Panzer III, the Ferdinand and StuG assault guns, the 50 mm assault gun, the 150 mm self-propelled howitzer, and a great many 88 mm Flak pieces converted to anti-tank use. The Luftwaffe flew Ju 87 Stukas and Henschel 129s in the ground-attack role, and the Soviets answered with Il-2 and Pe-2 covering their own infantry. Both sides mined heavily, the Soviet belts on the breach front running several kilometres deep, an attempt to blunt the German armour with sheer quantity of explosives.
tactics: 德軍的「雪崩」方案是典型的兩面夾擊：北面莫德爾的第9軍自奧廖爾沿鐵路兩側正面推進，南面第4裝甲集團軍自別爾哥羅德向北實施車楔形突擊，計畫在八至十日內會師於庫爾斯克，把蘇聯兩個方面軍切斷在突出部裡。蘇軍的對策是縱深消耗：先以梯次反坦克壕、機槍巢與地雷帶遲滯德軍前鋒，讓戰線始終黏在突出部前沿，再以絕對數量的炮火與坦克在突破部撕開缺口。德軍若沿一條軸線推進，縱深陣地會把前鋒吸乾；蘇軍卻把主要機動力量配置在縱深，等德軍人馬疲憊、指揮混亂才連續反衝。步兵方面，蘇軍以數百人的密集縱隊，在一至二千米縱深內連續實施反坦克衝鋒，用密集隊形與近迫射擊彌補反戰車火力的不足，拒絕以小隊分散前進。空軍上，德軍在作戰地域內取得明顯制空優勢，蘇軍只能以近距支援航空作戰掩護突破。八月三日蘇軍發動別爾哥羅德至哈爾科夫攻勢，四個方面軍在寬達百餘公里的正面同時出擊，前沿突破之後立刻轉為坦克與摩托化步兵的縱深追擊，德軍以縱深梯隊逐段抵抗，節節後撤。
tacticsEn: The German plan 'Citadel' was a classic two-sided pincer: in the north Model's 9th Army pushed frontally on both sides of the railway from Orel, while in the south the 4th Panzer Army drove a wedge of armoured vehicles north from Belgorod, the two arms intended to meet at Kursk within eight to ten days and cut the two Soviet fronts off inside the salient. The Soviet answer was to spend the depth: tiered anti-tank ditches, machine-gun nests and mine belts first slowed the German leading elements and pinned the line to the forward edge of the salient, and only when a breach was opened was massed artillery and armour poured through it. Pushed along a single axis, the German advance was drained away by the depth defences; the Soviets kept their main mobile forces in reserve further back and counterattacked only once the German advance was spent and its command disordered. On the infantry side the Soviets attacked in dense columns of several hundred men, making repeated anti-tank charges over one to two kilometres of depth, using mass and close-range fire to make up for the thinness of their anti-tank strength and refusing to advance in scattered platoons. In the air the Germans held clear local air superiority, and the Soviets could only cover their breakthrough with close air support. On 3 August the Soviet offensive from Belgorod towards Kharkov was launched, four fronts attacking side by side along a front over a hundred kilometres wide, and the moment the line was broken the effort turned into a deep pursuit by tank and motorised infantry, the Germans falling back stage by stage through a chain of prepared positions.
data: 可以核對的數字大致勾勒出會戰的規模。時間上，德軍北面攻勢自一九四三年七月五日展開，蘇軍別爾哥羅德至哈爾科夫反攻自八月三日發起，至八月二十三日哈爾科夫易手，北面蘇軍於八月十八日前後肅清奧廖爾突出部。德軍突擊兵力的常見引用數字是約二十五萬至三十萬人，坦克與突擊砲合計二千至三千輛，其中第4裝甲集團軍便擁有逾千輛戰車與自走砲；蘇軍方面軍群合計常記為一百三十萬至一百九十萬人、坦克約五千輛、炮兵逾一萬五千門，各家統計差異極大，蘇方數字多連預備與後勤部隊一併計入。損失方面，德軍一般記為陣亡與失聯合計五萬至七萬人，損失坦克數百輛、飛機逾千架；蘇軍常記二十萬人上下，其中不可恢復損失逾五萬人，坦克損失一千至二千輛。七月十二日普羅霍羅夫卡一日之內，參戰坦克常記八百至一千二百輛，說法互有出入。產能方面，蘇聯一九四三年產出 T-34/76 約二萬四千輛，說明物資補充並非瓶頸；而德軍虎式與豹式的產量分別只有數百輛上下，補充遠慢於消耗。歷時上，北面戰役約四十四日，南面反攻約二十日，推進距離約一百四十公里。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked sketch the scale of the battle. In time: the German offensive in the north opened on 5 July 1943, the Soviet counteroffensive from Belgorod towards Kharkov began on 3 August, Kharkov changed hands on 23 August, and the Soviets cleared the Orel salient around 18 August. For the German assault the figures usually quoted are about 250,000 to 300,000 men with two to three thousand tanks and assault guns between them, the 4th Panzer Army alone accounting for more than a thousand tracked vehicles and self-propelled guns; for the Soviet fronts the usual totals are 1.3 to 1.9 million men, some five thousand tanks and more than fifteen thousand guns, and the estimates differ widely because the Soviet figures tend to include reserves and rear-area troops. In losses the Germans are usually given fifty to seventy thousand dead and missing, several hundred tanks and more than a thousand aircraft lost; the Soviets are commonly given around two hundred thousand casualties, of whom over fifty thousand were irrecoverable, with one to two thousand tanks lost. In the single day at Prokhorovka on 12 July the number of tanks engaged is put anywhere from eight hundred to twelve hundred, and the figures disagree. In production: the Soviet Union built about 24,000 T-34/76s in 1943, which shows that materiel was not the constraint, while German output of Tigers and Panthers ran to only several hundred apiece, replacements lagging far behind losses. In duration the northern phase lasted about forty-four days and the southern counteroffensive about twenty, and the advance covered roughly one hundred and forty kilometres.
cause: 德軍發動會戰有三層動機。第一層是戰略上的急迫：一九四三年初蘇軍在斯大林格勒與高加索取得全線主動，德軍在「春潮」與第二次哈爾科夫戰役中屢遭挫敗，曼陀菲爾必須在突出部方向先行打掉蘇軍集結的中央與沃羅涅日方面軍，切斷其向頓巴斯反攻的策應樞紐，否則德軍在整條東線都只能退守。第二層是情報的落差與誤判：蘇軍以「露西」情報網掌握德軍參戰序列，得知原定的攻擊時程後提前通知前線，蘇軍據此在六月底搶先在奧廖爾方向動手，使德軍失去預期的奇襲效果；德軍自己則相信蘇軍有數十個師的預備隊會在縱深展開，卻未料到反攻來得又快又重。第三層是時間表與人事的拉扯：曼陀菲爾主張以更多時間補充裝甲與砲兵，希特勒要求速戰速決以免被西方登陸牽制，兩者的時間表衝突使攻勢最終卡在立即開打與再等等之間，最後定於七月五日展開。至於蘇軍，其戰役意圖正是利用德軍必須在突出部內動手的心理，把防守方的主動權用在選擇戰場與經營縱深上。
causeEn: The German attack had three layers of motive. The first was strategic urgency: in early 1943 the Soviets had taken the strategic initiative from Stalingrad to the Caucasus, and the Germans had been checked in the spring offensive and at the second battle of Kharkov, so Manstein had to destroy the massed Central and Voronezh fronts inside the salient and cut them off from their own counteroffensive in the Donbas, or the whole Eastern Front would become a defensive holding operation for him. The second was a gap in intelligence and a misjudgement: through the 'Lucy' network the Soviets learned the German order of battle and the intended timetable, warned the front in good time, and struck first at Orel at the end of June, so that the Germans lost the element of surprise; the Germans in turn believed that dozens of Soviet divisions were massed in the depths, and did not expect the counteroffensive to come so quickly and so heavily. The third was the tug-of-war over time and over men: Manstein wanted more time to replenish armour and artillery, Hitler wanted speed so that the Western landings would not distract the Wehrmacht, and the clash of the two timetables left the offensive balanced between immediate action and further delay, until 5 July was fixed. For the Soviets the intention was to exploit the fact that the Germans had to attack inside the salient, and to spend the defence's freedom of action on choosing the ground and building the depth.
impact: 會戰之後，德軍放棄了在突出部方向消滅蘇軍主力的企圖，東線的攻守形勢就此逆轉：此後德軍在蘇德戰線上未再主動發動戰略級的大攻勢，裝甲部隊改以營級合成、掩體與反擊為主，戰術上把坦克散開成小單位單獨作戰的作風被放棄。蘇軍則在這場戰役中把縱深機動理論、炮兵與坦克協同推到成熟：突擊集團軍集中使用，突破正面後由坦克集團軍高速追擊縱深，裝甲兵與近距支援航空的配合也從此定型，這套辦法在隨後的收復基輔等作戰中一再重現。技術層面的後果更為長遠，T-34/85 自一九四四年起成為蘇軍坦克部隊的標準配備，與 IS-2 一起構成東線後段的主力；德軍則體會到虎式與豹式的戰術原子抵擋不住有縱深、有生產力的對手，砲兵與工兵在防禦中的份量大幅上升。人事上，曼陀菲爾在一九四三年十月因與希姆勒在戰略與撤退問題上的衝突而被免去南方集團軍群司令員職務。同時，這場會戰也讓西方盟國看清軸心國在東線的消耗能力，加速了開闢第二戰場的節奏。
impactEn: After the battle the Germans gave up the intention of destroying the main Soviet forces in the salient, and the course of the Eastern Front turned over: from then on the Wehrmacht launched no strategic-scale offensive on that front of its own accord, and armoured units fought instead in regimental and divisional combined-arms groups, from cover and by counterattack, abandoning the practice of dispersing tanks into small independent tactical atoms. The Soviets, by contrast, brought deep-battle theory, artillery and armour cooperation to maturity: shock armies were concentrated, and once the front was broken the tank armies pursued into the depths at speed, with the pairing of armour and close air support fixed into doctrine, a method repeated in the liberation of Kiev and elsewhere. The technological consequences ran further still: the T-34-85 became the standard equipment of Soviet tank formations from 1944 and, with the IS-2, formed the backbone of the late-war Eastern Front; the Germans learned that the tactical atomisation of the Tiger and the Panther could not stand against an opponent with both depth and production capacity, and artillery and pioneers gained a much larger share in the defensive scheme. In personnel terms von Manstein was relieved of the Army Group South in October 1943 after his conflict with Himmler over strategy and the question of withdrawal. The battle also showed the Western Allies how badly the Axis was being worn down on the Eastern Front, and quickened the pace of the decision to open a second front.
result: 結局是德軍攻勢失敗、蘇軍保住突出部並奪回主動權。北面，蘇軍自七月五日先手進攻奧廖爾方向，一路上把德軍逐回原防線，五日別爾哥羅德與奧廖爾相繼解放；南面，八月三日開始的別爾哥羅德至哈爾科夫攻勢由四個方面軍實施，八月二十三日蘇軍進入哈爾科夫，德軍退往南面更為堅固的陣地，九月初蘇軍基本肅清整個突出部，前後二十日推進約一百四十公里。七月十二日的普羅霍羅夫卡交鋒常被視為德軍裝甲攻勢的頂點，其結果並未改變戰局走向。德軍在會戰中損失慘重但未被重創，得以退守並恢復戰力；蘇軍以更大的代價換取了戰役的主動權，把庫爾斯克變成自己的進攻出發點，隨後一九四四年全年沿北面戰線向德涅斯特河與基輔方向推進。卡面上的 T-34-85 雖未參加一九四三年七月的這場交鋒，卻是這場勝利直接催生出來的產物：量產化的中型坦克配上八十五公厘砲，使蘇軍的縱深突破在裝備上有了正式前提。
resultEn: The outcome was that the German offensive failed, the Soviets held the salient and took the initiative. In the north the Soviets struck first at Orel on 5 July and pushed the Germans back onto their original lines, liberating Belgorod and Orel on the 5th; in the south the offensive from Belgorod towards Kharkov, launched on 3 August by four fronts, entered Kharkov on 23 August, the Germans falling back to firmer positions further south, and by the beginning of September the Soviets had largely cleared the whole salient, advancing some one hundred and forty kilometres in twenty days. The tank clash at Prokhorovka on 12 July is usually treated as the high point of the German armoured offensive, but it did not alter the course of the campaign. The Germans lost heavily without being crushed, and were able to fall back and rebuild their strength; the Soviets paid a larger price and in return won the initiative, turning Kursk into the springboard for their own offensives, and through 1944 they drove northwards along the front towards the Dniester and Kiev. The T-34-85 on the card face did not fight in the July 1943 clash, but it was a direct product of that victory: a mass-produced medium tank with an 85 mm gun gave the Soviet deep breakthrough a proper equipment basis.
